title: Meeting the Moment Together: A Summer 2026 Update on P&G Disaster Relief
summary: Learn how the P&G Disaster Relief Program delivers essential products and services to help communities worldwide recover after disasters in our 2026 mid-year update.
body_markdown:
## P&G Disaster Relief: Frequently Asked Questions


***What is the P&G Disaster Relief Program?***


The[P&G Disaster Relief Program](https://us.pg.com/community-impact/disaster-relief/) supports communities affected by natural disasters and other unexpected challenges around the world. The program has three primary components: providing trusted everyday products from P&G brands; offering essential services such as mobile laundry and showers in the U.S. and localized services internationally; and supporting relief organizations through grants that help them carry out critical response and recovery efforts.


***What products and services does P&G provide after a disaster?***


Depending on local needs, P&G and its partners may distribute cleaning, health, hygiene, and household essentials from the same brands families use every day, including Always, Bounty, Charmin, Crest, Dawn, Head & Shoulders, Old Spice, Pampers, Pantene, and Tide.


In the U.S., the P&G Disaster Relief Fleet also provides services including[Tide Loads of Hope](https://tide.com/en-us/our-commitment/loads-of-hope) , which offers free full-service laundry, and mobile shower units with private, accessible bathrooms and personal care products.


***Who does P&G partner with on disaster relief?***


P&G works with local, national, and international disaster relief organizations around the world. We have a longstanding partnership with[Matthew 25: Ministries](https://m25m.org/work/disaster-relief/) , who leads much of our U.S. disaster response. P&G also partners with organizations including[Americares](https://www.americares.org/) ,[Direct Relief](https://www.directrelief.org/) ,[GlobalMedic](https://globalmedic.ca/) ,[Save the Children](https://www.savethechildren.org/) , and[World Vision](https://www.worldvision.org/) . These organizations provide the local knowledge, logistics, and operational expertise that help P&G products, services, and financial support reach communities based on needs on the ground.


***How does P&G decide when and where to respond to a disaster?***


P&G works with our disaster relief partners to assess factors, including the scale and severity of a disaster, needs on the ground, safety and feasibility, and the response already underway. The type of support can vary by disaster and location, with the goal of directing products, services, and funding where they can be useful to affected communities.


***How can I help?***


Learn more about supporting our partners' relief efforts on their websites or visit the[P&G Disaster Relief](https://us.pg.com/community-impact/disaster-relief/) website for more information.
